SELECT dateDiff('second',
                least(fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}), toDateTime(max(event_time))),
                fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64}))
       / greatest(dateDiff('second', fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}), fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})), 1)
       AS windows_stale
FROM inmobi.ad_events_enriched
WHERE event_time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})

SELECT toUInt64(sum(is_anomaly)) AS anomaly_count
FROM (
WITH points AS (
    SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(toUnixTimestamp(event_time) - 1785649885, 2) * 2 + 1785649885) AS ts,
           d.1 AS dim_name,
           d.2 AS dim_value,
           sum(revenue) AS actual,
           sum(revenue) AS num,
           0 AS den,
           count() AS sample_count
    FROM inmobi.ad_events_enriched
    ARRAY JOIN [('ALL', '')] AS d
    WHERE event_time > (fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64}) - INTERVAL 3360 SECOND) AND event_time <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
    GROUP BY ts, dim_name, dim_value
    -- vertical / campaign_type are empty on unfilled requests; that is an absence,
    -- not a segment, and it must never become a candidate slice
    HAVING dim_name = 'ALL' OR dim_value != ''
),
windowed AS (
    SELECT ts, dim_name, dim_value, actual, num, den, sample_count,
           quantileExact(0.5)(actual)  OVER w AS base_median,
           quantileExact(0.25)(actual) OVER w AS base_q25,
           quantileExact(0.75)(actual) OVER w AS base_q75,
           sum(num)                    OVER w AS base_num,
           sum(den)                    OVER w AS base_den,
           count()                     OVER w AS base_points
    FROM points
    WINDOW w AS (
        PARTITION BY dim_name, dim_value, (intDiv(toUnixTimestamp(ts) - 1785649885, 2)) % 24, (intDiv(intDiv(toUnixTimestamp(ts) - 1785649885, 2), 24) + 0) % 7 >= 5
        ORDER BY ts
        ROWS BETWEEN 20 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    )
),
based AS (
    SELECT ts, dim_name, dim_value, actual, num, den, sample_count, base_points,
           base_num, base_den,
           base_median AS expected,
           greatest((base_q75 - base_q25) / 1.349, 1e-9) AS robust_sigma
    FROM windowed
    WHERE ts > fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
),
scored AS (
    SELECT ts, dim_name, dim_value, actual, expected, sample_count, base_points,
           actual - expected AS delta_abs,
           if(expected IS NULL OR expected = 0, NULL,
              (actual - expected) / expected) AS delta_rel,
           if(expected IS NULL, NULL, (actual - expected) / robust_sigma) AS z_score
    FROM based
)
SELECT ts, dim_name, dim_value, actual, expected, delta_abs, delta_rel, z_score,
       sample_count, base_points,
       ifNull(sample_count >= 2000
              AND base_points >= 8
              AND abs(z_score) >= 4.0
              AND abs(delta_rel) >= 0.03, 0) AS is_anomaly
FROM scored
)
